_page: Appeals (Content → Appeals → New appeal). One object per appeal, keyed by the Admin form's field labels in order; null = leave empty. Copied from apps/web/src/content/appeals.js (APPEAL_RECORDS). These are the website's four SAMPLE appeals (decision D8/D31): confirm or replace them before publishing. The first published appeal replaces the website's whole appeal list, so publish the set together. Emergency appeals appear at /appeals/emergency/<address>, campaigns at /appeals/campaigns/<address>; the Summary and Featured image show on appeal cards and in the Appeals menu; the Circle label and image show in the story circles over the navbar.

Basic information.Title: Emergency Appeal 01
Basic information.Summary: When a crisis strikes, families need essentials quickly. This appeal funds an immediate response — and support as they recover.

\"Why it matters\" paragraphs: When a crisis strikes, the first days matter most. Families can lose access to food, clean water and shelter almost overnight.
This appeal supports an immediate response alongside local partners, and stays with families through the weeks of recovery that follow.

How support helps — items.title: Support as families recover and rebuild

Trust panel — if \"This appeal's own wor.Body: Supporters should always be able to see how our work is run and how resources are used.

Content.Questions: None (as before) — the website's appeal pages show no questions; choose "This appeal's own questions" and use the block below to add them

Questions and answers.question: Can I choose what my donation supports?
Questions and answers.answer: Yes. You can give to a specific emergency appeal or campaign from this page, or give where support is needed most — which lets us direct your gift to wherever it can do the most good across our four program areas.

Questions and answers.question: How are donations used?
Questions and answers.answer: Donations support our work across education, health and wellbeing, livelihoods and community support. Our transparency and financial information shows how our work is run and how resources are used.

Questions and answers.question: What if I need to change or ask about a donation?
Questions and answers.answer: Please contact us through our Contact page with the details of your gift, and we will help.

Questions and answers.question: Can I give on behalf of a business or organisation?
Questions and answers.answer: Yes. Organisations can give, and many choose to partner with us in other ways too. Get in touch through our Partner With Us page to talk about what would suit you.

Featured media.Featured image: Upload RBB's own photo (required). Website placeholder was demo-comm-relief-packing.jpg (Pexels) — alt: Two volunteers packing supplies into cardboard boxes

SEO.SEO description: Support an immediate response for families facing a crisis — essentials, safe water and hygiene supplies, and help as they recover and rebuild.

Basic information.Title: Emergency Appeal 02
Basic information.Summary: Support for communities facing a sudden emergency, delivered with care and with local partners.

\"Why it matters\" paragraphs: Emergencies hit hardest where support is already stretched. This appeal helps communities meet urgent needs while longer-term help is organised.
Everything is planned with the people affected, so support reaches those who need it most.

Basic information.Title: Campaign 01
Basic information.Summary: A campaign to widen access to learning, so more children can read, learn and keep learning.

\"Why it matters\" paragraphs: Too many children still miss out on learning because of cost, distance or a lack of books and teachers.
This campaign supports reading clubs, learning materials and teachers — practical steps that open the door to learning.

Basic information.Title: Campaign 02
Basic information.Summary: A campaign for clean water close to home — and the care that keeps it flowing.

\"Why it matters\" paragraphs: Clean water close to home changes everything: health, time for school and work, and dignity.
This campaign supports repairs to community water points and training local volunteers to look after them.
